title: Validity under source padding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Boolean Turing machine, let $m$ be a natural number, let $l$ be a finite list of sources, and let $\rho$ assign natural-number values to eleven registers. If every source in $l$ is valid, then every source in the list formed by appending enough constant false sources to reach length $m$ (or appending none if $l$ already has length at least $m$) is valid.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment $\rho$ of natural numbers to eleven registers
